title: 第三章 以礼辱之第四章 三年之约不半年
content_zh:
众人寻声向门外望去，只见一少年正朝屋里走来。
来人正是楚天舒！
楚玥看着朝她走来的少年，脸上突然闪过一抹愧疚，这件事毕竟是她毁约在先。
“天舒，你……”楚鸿刚想说什么，就被楚天舒打断，“爹，此事因我而起，就让我来解决吧。”
楚鸿看着儿子，无奈地叹了口气，随后他点点头，默许了他的行为。
楚鸿一时之间也想不出什么好的办法，但他知道自己儿子的聪明才智，想必儿子已是想到了解决方法，能让他们一家人“体面”一些。
楚天舒盯着楚玥，在众多家老的注视下缓缓开口：“拿来。”
“什么啊？”
“最后还不是拿了丹药。”
“得了三枚筑脉丹，算是天大的福气了。”
“真羡慕这小子……”
楚玥将木盒递过，她歉然道：“天舒族弟，你知道的，我一直以来都把你当做弟弟看待，并没有那种男女之情，况且我也不喜……”
话到此处，戛然而止！
楚玥瞪大了双眼，瞳孔微缩。只见楚天舒将木盒倾斜，三枚珍贵无比的筑脉丹滚落在地。
一时间，府内众人心脏不由得跟着提到了嗓子眼！
他要干什么？那可是三品丹药！更是出自南元城顶尖炼药师之手！
楚天舒面无表情，一脚踩下！鞋底用力碾磨地板，发出细微的“沙沙”声。
三枚三品丹药就这么被踩成了“药粉”！
“疯了吧？三品丹药都不要！”
“枉费楚玥的一番好意，不识抬举。”

“只有一条灵脉还想癞蛤蟆吃天鹅肉，玥儿可是八灵脉的天骄，楚家年轻一辈最强者，怎么想都不会嫁给你。”
……
“天啊，哥今天这是怎么了？”角落某处，楚天清惊讶出声，这还是他认识的那个哥哥吗？
“你你……”楚玥眸子仿佛要渗出火来，脸色更是难看到了极点。脸上那一抹愧疚瞬间消失。
大长老怒不可遏：“不知好歹！你小子不过是个独灵脉的废物罢了，还想翻了天不成！”
原本沉默不语的三长老开口道：“玥儿这也是为你好，若不是顾及颜面，她……”
“好一个顾及颜面，从我得知我是独灵脉到现在，也不过短短三天，她就如此迫不及待地领着你和大长老，带着一群家老冲进府里逼着我爹在议事堂内当着众位家老的面退婚。”楚天舒反问道，“你管这叫顾及颜面？”
“吼什么？你小子怎么跟长辈说话的？”三长老呵斥道。
楚天舒转过头，对上楚玥双目，说道：“今日你带着这些人来退婚，丢尽了我父母的脸面，而我也彻底成了个笑话。我若真收下了筑脉丹和灵兵，那旁人怎么看我楚天舒？又怎么看我们一家？我爹作为族长的威严何在？作为云脉首领的脸面又何在？”
一语惊人！
原本还在看热闹，为楚玥鸣不平的家老们瞬间安静了下来。
大长老见计谋被识破，脸色不由得阴沉了起来：“这小子……今天怎么这么有种？”
content_en:
Everyone looked out the door and saw a young man walking towards the house.
The person coming is none other than Chu Tianshu!
Chu Yue looked at the young man walking towards her, and a flash of guilt suddenly flashed across her face. After all, she broke the contract first.
"Tianshu, you..." Chu Hong was about to say something when he was interrupted by Chu Tianshu, "Dad, this happened because of me, so let me solve it."
Chu Hong looked at his son and sighed helplessly, then he nodded and acquiesced to his behavior.
Chu Hong couldn't think of any good solution for a while, but he knew his son's intelligence, so he must have thought of a solution to make their family more "decent".
Chu Tianshu stared at Chu Yue, and slowly said under the gaze of many family elders: "Bring it here."
"What?"
"I didn't get the elixir in the end."
"It is a great blessing to receive three pulse-building pills."
"I really envy this boy..."
Chu Yue handed over the wooden box and said apologetically: "Brother Tianshu, you know, I have always treated you as a younger brother. There is no such thing as a man and a woman. Besides, I don't like it either..."
The words stopped abruptly here!
Chu Yue's eyes widened and her pupils shrank. Chu Tianshu tilted the wooden box, and three extremely precious pulse-building pills rolled to the ground.
For a moment, everyone in the house could not help but feel their hearts rising to their throats!
What is he going to do? That is a third-grade elixir! It comes from the hands of Nanyuan City’s top alchemist!
Chu Tianshu had no expression on his face and stepped on it! The soles of the shoes grind hard against the floor, making a slight "swishing" sound.
Three third-grade elixirs were trampled into "medicine powder"!
"Are you crazy? You don't want any third-grade elixir!"
"It's a waste of all Chu Yue's good intentions. I don't know how to appreciate him."
"You only have one spiritual vein and you still want to eat swan meat. Yue'er is the genius of the eight spiritual veins. She is the strongest among the younger generation of the Chu family. I will never marry you no matter what."
…
"Oh my god, brother, what happened today?" Somewhere in the corner, Chu Tianqing asked in surprise. Is this still the brother he knew?
"You, you..." Chu Yue's eyes seemed to be filled with fire, and her face was extremely ugly. The trace of guilt on his face disappeared instantly.
The great elder was furious: "I don't know what is wrong! You are just a waste with a single spiritual vein, and you still want to turn the world upside down!"
The third elder who was silent at first said, "Yue'er is doing this for your own good. If she hadn't taken her face into consideration, she would..."
"What a person who cares about face. It has only been just three days since I learned that I have a single spirit pulse. She has been so impatient to lead you and the elder, and a group of family elders to rush into the house and force my father to cancel the engagement in front of all the family elders in the council hall." Chu Tianshu asked in return, "Do you call this caring about face?"
"What are you yelling at? Why are you talking to your elders?" the third elder scolded.
Chu Tianshu turned his head, looked into Chu Yue's eyes, and said: "Today you brought these people to break off the engagement, which has disgraced my parents, and I have become a complete joke. If I really accept the pulse-building pill and the spiritual weapon, what will others think of me, Chu Tianshu? How will they think of our family? Where is my father's majesty as a clan leader? Where is his face as the leader of Yunmai?"
An astonishing statement!
The elders who were still watching the excitement and complaining about Chu Yue suddenly fell silent.
Seeing that the plan was discovered, the great elder's expression turned gloomy: "This kid...why is he so smart today?"
